id.description: Short unique identifier, e.g. F-AUTH-001 or F-PAY-002

title.description: Clear, descriptive title of the vulnerability

domain.description: Functional domain (e.g. auth, payment, traversal-filesystem, api)

cwe.description: CWE ID, e.g. CWE-89, CWE-22, CWE-79

owasp.description: OWASP Top 10 category, e.g. A01:2021 or API1:2023

severity.description: Severity rating derived from CVSS score

confidence.description: Confidence level based on proof of exploitability

reproducibility.description: Reproducibility state: confirmed-poc (tested & verified), likely-trace (code flow traced but env limited), theoretical-pattern (static analysis only)

files.description: List of affected files and line numbers (e.g. path/to/file.go:123)

description.description: Detailed explanation of the flaw and its root cause

data_flow.description: Attacker-controlled source -> transformation -> sensitive sink flow

poc_command.description: Exact shell command to run the reproduction PoC test

poc_test_path.description: Path to the reproduction test file relative to repo root

remediation.description: Concrete code fix or configuration change for this specific stack

deployment_preconditions.description: Configuration or deployment preconditions required for exploitability

requires_wiring.description: One-line configuration or wiring change that mitigates the issue

production_reachable.description: Whether reachable in default production deploy, only if configured, or dev surface only
